name: universe-v1
selectedBefore: any backtest, forward test or data download for this strategy. No results existed when this list was written.
method: Large, liquid US-listed stocks and unlevered ETFs chosen by sector, not by past breakout performance. One AI/technology cluster is deliberately included (the owner's main interest) and tagged so correlated exposure can be measured; it is limited to 5 of 17 names so it cannot dominate the sample by count.
exclusions: No leveraged or inverse ETFs, no OTC or non-US listings, no names with under 2 million shares average daily volume.
notes: VRT and MU are also in the owner's real watchlist/portfolio; the simulated account is separate and never reads or changes real holdings. NVDA, AMD, MU, MSFT and VRT tend to move together; results are reported with and without this cluster.
